about.title: Third-year computer engineering student who builds and ships web apps.
bio: I'm a third-year Computer Engineering student at Pamukkale University. I started with C and Java; today I build web apps end to end, from the API to the interface, and deploy what I build.
I care about the details on both sides: clear data models, access rules that hold, and an interface that stays out of the way.
Outside of code: Formula 1, cars, and whatever shipped this week.
